sections.title: A room, one surface at a time
sections.content: Now put -on/-en/-ön to work describing a real room: fal ("wall"), mennyezet ("ceiling"), padló ("floor"), and polc ("shelf") are all surfaces things rest on. bútor ("furniture") is the general word for all of it together.

items.english: The shelf is on the wall.
The lamp is on the ceiling.
There are a lot of books on the shelf.

sections.content: padló and lépcső both already end in a vowel, so they just take a bare -n — padlón, lépcsőn — instead of a separate -on/-en/-ön.
